verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade the moment Renekton crosses 50 Fury with W up; you win if you wait him out, then chain Q into E when his dash and stun are both down.

brief.thesis: Both champions fight in short, resource-gated bursts: Renekton's Q, W, and E only get their bonus damage, extra stun, and armor shred once he holds more than 50 Fury, while Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance empowered auto and Umbral Dash passive heal reward drawn-out trades. The matchup is decided by whether Renekton lands his empowered W stun-chain before Aatrox's sustain outpaces it — the 329-game sample sits at 51.1% for Aatrox, so neither side should force it.

theirWindow.when: Renekton above 50 Fury with W up
theirWindow.what: His W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a three-hit stun that strips shields and hits much harder, and his Q (Cull the Meek) heals more too. Do not stand and trade here — hold Umbral Dash to reposition rather than engage.

yourWindow.when: his E is on cooldown or Fury under 50
yourWindow.what: Slice and Dice sits on a 16 to 10s cooldown depending on rank, and his Q/W lose their bonus effects below 50 Fury. Walk into a Q (The Darkin Blade) into E (Umbral Dash) trade here to bank the passive heal before he can dash away or reset his stun.

start.why: Highest win rate start (49.6% over 242 games, 59.3% pick) — the extra sustain matters against a champion whose Q also heals him, keeping trades even instead of losing the attrition race.

boots.why: 87.5% pick rate and the standard choice here — Renekton's damage is all basic-attack and physical-ability based, and the flat reduction blunts his empowered W and auto-heavy trades.

core.why: The proc shield and burst window matches Aatrox's short trade patterns and punishes Renekton for committing into a fight.
On-hit healing and the crit proc stack with Deathbringer Stance to keep Aatrox's sustain ahead through the level 9-13 spike.
Converts the burst taken from an empowered W stun-chain into delayed damage, so a single Fury-fueled all-in doesn't just kill you outright.

situational.when: you're ahead and want faster Q/W/E cooldowns to keep snowballing the lead
renekton itemizes tanky and threatens to burst through your healing in the stun chain
the game runs long and you need armor shred to keep trading through his kit

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained trading this matchup is built around — stacking adaptive force through extended fights matches Aatrox's E and passive healing loop better than a burst keystone.

summoners.why: 74% pick rate and the highest win rate combo (50%) — Ignite converts Aatrox's solo-kill advantage into actual kills during the level 6-8 sustain window. Flash+Teleport (46.7% wr, 22.8% pick) is the fallback if you need to prioritize wave/tempo instead.

playing.title: Trade only when his E is down
playing.detail: Slice and Dice is his only reset/reposition tool on a 16 to 10s cooldown. Once he's used it to engage or retreat, that's your window to step in and trade freely.

playing.title: Punish sub-50 Fury Renekton
playing.detail: His Q and W lose their bonus damage, heal, and stun duration below 50 Fury. All-in during these windows instead of after he's topped off Fury on the wave.

playing.title: Combo Q into E, not just Q
playing.detail: Chain The Darkin Blade into Umbral Dash so the dash's on-hit heal triggers off the same trade, then use the dash again to disengage before his Fury rebuilds.

playing.title: Bank E for his stun
playing.detail: Keep Umbral Dash off cooldown heading into his W range. It's your only way to blink out of a 0.75s (or 1.5s empowered) stun before he follows up.

playing.title: Weave Deathbringer Stance every trade
playing.detail: The empowered auto's magic damage and heal scale off Renekton's max HP — never skip it in a trade, since it's the passive most directly offsetting his own Q sustain.

playing.title: Save R for forced skirmishes, not single stuns
playing.detail: World Ender's 120/100/80s cooldown and extended duration on takedown pay off in longer level 6+ fights where your healing wins out, not in trading into one isolated W stun.

playing.title: Don't overextend past minions
playing.detail: His E is a 450-range dash — staying inside wave range denies him the runway to close and chain straight into his stun.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the timing reads, trade windows, and power curve are my own analysis of the ability kits.
